title: Idle Eden: A browser-based incremental space sim with economy, mining, fleet management and combat inspired by EVE Online
author: SensitiveBike6034

comments.author: SensitiveBike6034
comments.body:
Playable in browser (no download or sign-up):  
[https://nightdriftstudios.itch.io/idle-eden](https://nightdriftstudios.itch.io/idle-eden)  
(Also on Galaxy: [https://galaxy.click](https://galaxy.click) )

comments.author: radialmonster
comments.body:
Looks really neat.  lots of depth it seems.

For me, personal taste, but I'd like the text and ui to be a bit brighter, the dark background is fine, but im finding the text and ui a bit difficult, but not bad.  

will check it out more

replies.author: SensitiveBike6034
replies.body: I appreciate the feedback, radialmonster. Let me look into the text and UI elements to make it easier to read.

replies.author: SensitiveBike6034
replies.body: u/radialmonster I just pushed an update that brightens up all the text, labels, and UI elements across the board while keeping the dark space background intact. It's much crisper and easier on the eyes now. Hope you enjoy checking it out more!

replies.author: radialmonster
replies.body: Yes it is much easier to read now thank you!

replies.author: SensitiveBike6034
replies.body: Excellent to hear! I'm in the middle of two major updates as well. The first one will introduce up to Tier 3 for all the existing ships. The second major update will introduce a full story mode campaign with 3 distinct endings and unique rewards for playing the story mode campaign.
